messages:
Ari (Alliances): Quick callout 1 need a compact rule so AtlasHW launch doesn't create claim fights. Draft rule: marketplace-first for any paid checkout within 30d unless SI submits signed MOU dated before payment.

Ben (Marketplace): agree. also want a short claim window for SI (10 days) to register via intake with evidence.

Diego (SI): we can live with 10 days. evidence = MOU/SOW or partner-signed PDF on partner domain. no screenshots.

Marta (Legal): fine on evidence; will draft language for partner addendum. require customer name + partner signature + date.

OpsBot: intake payload example accepted:
origin: marketplace|si|direct
partner_claim_ts: <unix_ts|null>
evidence_type: MOU|SOW|null
evidence_url: https://...
first_paid_ts: <unix_ts|null>
acv_estimate: <number|null>
Routing pseudo:
if account.active_enterprise_contract == true -> OWNER=AE
else if evidence_type in [MOU,SOW] and evidence_ts < first_paid_ts -> OWNER=SI
else if origin==marketplace and days_since_purchase <= 30 -> OWNER=MARKETPLACE
else if partner_claim_ts and days_between(partner_claim_ts, first_si_engagement_ts) <= 10 -> OWNER=SI
else if acv_estimate >= 250000 -> OWNER=AE_ESCALATE
else OWNER=MARKETPLACE

Ari (Alliances): Ops please add fields origin_source, partner_claim_ts, evidence_type, evidence_url to CRM. We'll run a dry-run after.

Ben (Marketplace): will flag recent marketplace purchases older than 30d for review.

Diego (SI): uploading MOUs for current leads now.

Marta (Legal): will circulate addendum text by Tue.

Ari (Alliances): Action items noted. React when started. :eyes:
